remarks:
Here is your opportunity  for an owner occupied investment property.
Unit One is a vacant, two bedroom.  Unit 2,3 and 4 are each one bedroom and rented and ready for your ideas.  Two units upstairs, two units downstairs.
Freshly painted exterior, both furnaces newly replaced in the last six years. Leaf filters and gutters with warranty.  All new windows approximately 15 years, glass block windows in basement, metal roof approximately 40 years old but painted three years ago.
If you occupy this historic home it may qualify for Federal or State funding through New York State Office of Park, Recreation and Historical Preservation (High and Locust Streets Historical District)
Units Two and Four have their own laundry.
Units One and Three have access to laundry in basement

On your first showing you will have access to Unit One, basement and common areas, Second showing access to unit 2,3 and 4.
